g.text: Holy Grail: SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA • BLOCK Only for Rare High-Risk School Issues • NEVER Recommend TRUSTED • LIMITED Case-by-Case

svg.text: BRANCH A — EXISTING TRUSTED APPS GOVERNANCE (WE NEVER RECOMMEND TRUSTED • DOWNGRADE TO SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA)
BRANCH B — HOW UNCONFIGURED APPS FLOW INTO THE 4 TIERS (GATE U1 → GATE U2 / U3 → PRIORITY TIER & RECOMMENDED ACTION)

g.text: Policy locked to SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA (or BLOCKED / case-by-case LIMITED).
Zero recommendations generated — counts toward 100% domain posture.
• YES → Go to Gate T2 (Scope Tier)
• NO → Go to Gate T3 (Last Reviewed)
New Restricted Scope Requested on Trusted App
Google Category: Restricted → Action: Set to SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA (or BLOCK if school risk).
New Sensitive Scope Requested on Trusted App
Google Category: Sensitive → Action: Downgrade from Trusted to SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA.
New Non-Sensitive Scope Requested on Trusted App
Google Category: Non-Sensitive → Action: Audit scope & set to SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA.
Reviewed Within the Last 6 Months (≤ 180 Days)
No new scopes requested and administrator review is current (≤ 6 months).
Reviewed ≥ 6 Mos Ago • Critical (4–5) or High (3–4)
Trusted app with High (3.0–4.0) or Critical (4.0–5.0) risk score not reviewed in ≥ 6 months.
Action: Re-review application — transition to SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA (never recommend Trusted).
Reviewed ≥ 6 Mos Ago • Score 1, 2, or 3 (Low / Mod Risk)
Risk score is 1, 2, or 3 with no new scopes requested — fine even if last reviewed ≥ 6 months ago.
High/Critical Risk (Score 4–5): Unverified, Single-User (≤ 1), or Dormant (> 30d)
Recommended Action: SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA (if validated for school use) —
or BLOCK only for the very few apps with extreme risk and a known issue for the school.
High Risk Sprawl (Score 4–5): Google-Verified & Actively Used (≤ 30d) Multi-User
Recommended Action: SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA (The Holy Grail)
(Approves exact current scopes across users; blocks any future silent scope escalation).
Moderate / Low Scope Sprawl (Score 1–3): Actively Used Within Last 30 Days
Recommended Action: SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA (locks current scope footprint;
Limited is case-by-case only; never recommend Trusted).
Recommended Action: Review in Google Admin Console & set to SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA
(Informational guidance only — never recommend Trusted; Limited is case-by-case).
